New practices or technologies or information/knowledge
• Machine for sowing
• Machine harvesting
• Tractor for ploughing the fields
• Use of pesticide called “total”
• Use of urea and “jaivik” fertilizers
• Use of the hybrid seed, 446
• Thresher and harvester for separating the crop
• Use of engine and CD for irrigation purposes (CD is lighter than engine)

Most important for the [sex of the FGD] of the community (top 2)
• Use of machine for sowing
• Use of machine for harvesting

Most important for the [opposite sex of FGD] of the community (top 2)
• Use of engine and CD for irrigation
• Thresher and harvester for separating the crop

Machines like harvester, engine and CD are very heavy and cannot be used by women
Both have equal rights; if there is no man in the house and the woman is aware then she will do it
